name: ns_track_b_paraproduct_2026-05-04
description: Four-branch paraproduct grid extracted from advisor_channel Turn 17 and the Phase 5FS/5FT Lean bridge. Each branch is a falsification target for the Track B Clay closure: produce either a Lean charging estimate under a fixed LP/Besov/Sobolev topology or a deterministic Python audit exhibiting a paraproduct-class failure.

cross_cutting_obligations.name: finite branch falsifier surface
cross_cutting_obligations.obligation: Every Track B branch must either instantiate its predeclared analytic receipt under the fixed Leray/Sobolev/LP topology or produce a finite witness matching the checked falsifier spine: low/high leakage shortfall, high-high receipt shortfall, residual charge shortfall, profile arbitrage, countable-limit price drop, low-frequency reserve underpricing, null-profile arbitrage, or matrix negative threshold-root gap

cross_cutting_obligations.name: matrix-block observable admissibility and ledger charging
cross_cutting_obligations.obligation: W-independent off-diagonal matrix blocks are excluded only by translation covariance; any W-coupled/global matrix block kept in scope must predeclare the observable and charge PSD ballast, damping, independent normalization, and cross terms before payoff is scored
evidence_anchors: Phase 5FA/5FB finite PSD and lifted quartic certificates

cross_cutting_obligations.name: universal state-pricing null/interacting split
cross_cutting_obligations.obligation: Before global Track B closure is claimed, fix the state space, observable class, price terms, normalization, and matrix-block policy; prove either the null-route cap gamma <= 2/3 or exact quartic root coercivity for interacting above-wall routes, with cross terms and matrix blocks charged by the same ledger
evidence_anchors: Phase 5FA/5FB finite PSD and lifted quartic certificates

cross_cutting_obligations.name: exact PSD/SOS receipt for the threshold-root ledger
cross_cutting_obligations.obligation: A claimed universal kernel must provide a lossless identity writing the exact threshold defect gap at t=sqrt((2/3)/gamma) as nonnegative slack plus sum-of-squares terms; Lean verifies the receipt and routes it into the universal state-pricing split
evidence_anchors: Phase 5FA/5FB finite PSD and lifted quartic certificates

branches.name: low-high catalyst charging
branches.obligation: low-frequency catalyst terms must be charged by the declared Leray/paraproduct price before they can stretch high-frequency modes

branches.name: high-low transport charging
branches.obligation: high-frequency transport against low-frequency structure must be priced without changing the observable class after payoff is seen

branches.name: high-high self-tax charging
branches.obligation: high-high cascade payoff cannot survive while Leray-projected self-tax cancels below the exact quartic survival allowance

branches.name: same-shell remainder and countable-limit charging
branches.obligation: same-shell/remainder/cross payoff must be charged before the countable limit; limiting payoff must be finite-prefix visible and price lower-semicontinuous; no-survivor prefixes must control the low-frequency Lipschitz continuation quantity
evidence_anchors: Phase 5FV low-high PDE estimate reality check
Phase 5FZ profile-pricing to Lipschitz-control Clay bridge
